_note: Six prepared stimuli for the Part C instrument. ALL SYNTHETIC: company names are invented (synthetic: true) and modelled on the structure of real sources (MOM EA Directory status, brand-impersonation press statements, CASE company alerts, no-result pages, police news about a non-employment matter). Wording is the draft product wording under test, written by the specialist; it is not final copy.

stimuli.text:
Employer check: Brightwell Staffing Pte Ltd.
Found in an official list: MOM Employment Agencies Directory shows this agency's licence as SUSPENDED (list read 10 Nov 2026). Source: MOM Employment Agencies Directory, 'Under Revocation/Suspension/Surveillance'. This is a record of a regulator action against this agency.

Employer check: Northgate Recruitment Pte Ltd.
Found: SCAM WARNING ABOUT THIS NAME. Northgate Recruitment published a notice (Aug 2022) that scammers are posing as its staff on Telegram and asking candidates to pay fees for fake jobs. Source: Northgate Recruitment press statement. This warning is about people imitating the brand.

Employer check: Lumen Hair Studio.
Found: CASE (Consumers Association of Singapore) company alert listing this business for consumer complaints, 2023 to 2024. Source: CASE company alert list. This is a consumer-complaint alert and not a finding by a regulator.

Employer check: Orchard Peak Logistics Pte Ltd (company confirmed in the ACRA register).
Nothing found in the sources checked: MOM Employment Agencies Directory flagged list, MOM stop-work orders (Jan to Sep 2026), MAS enforcement actions, CASE company alerts. Checked 10 Nov 2026.

Employer check: 'Sunrise Services'.
Nothing found in the sources checked. We could not confirm which registered company this name refers to, so the check used the name only.

Employer check: FreshBite Foods Pte Ltd.
Found: news report (2024) that police are investigating misuse of the company's mobile ordering app by scammers. Source: news report. This item is about the app and customers, not about employment.
